newsitem.title: GREECE: DRACHMA UP VS ECU ON FX INFLOWS, RATES EYE TENDER.
newsitem.headline: DRACHMA UP VS ECU ON FX INFLOWS, RATES EYE TENDER.

text.p: The drachma was gaining ground against the ecu on the back of ecu selling by local and foreign players seeking funding for Tuesday's auction of three-, five-, seven- and 10-year bonds, dealers said.

"Ecu/drachma opened at 309.70 but is currently trading around 309.25/35 on ecu selling," said a senior dealer at a private bank. "Some players seek drachma funding for the bond auction and others think ecu/drachma is too high at these levels."
Depos were holding, eyeing the central bank's 11.90 percent depo tender of 14-day funds on Wednesday. Forex forwards were easier on forex inflows.
Bank of Greece offered to drain 14-funds at 11.90 percent in its regular depo tender. A pact of 200 billion drachmas is expiring today.
Bonds were idling, looking for clues in the behaviour of money market rates and the outcome of the central bank's depo tender.
"We can go either way depending on liquidity conditions," said a bond dealer. "Some inflows from the forex have helped maintain equilibrium in the bond market so far."
The mark was quoted at 159.05/15 from Tuesday's 159.230 fix, the dollar at 272.11/21 drachmas from 272.800 and the ecu at 309.41/51 from 309.930 drachmas.
The National Bank of Greece quoted the following early rates:
** Six months at 10.60-11.10 ** Nine months at 10.40-10.90
